PermissionSet.label: SCRUM442_Satisfaction_Read
PermissionSet.description: SCRUM-442 Read-PS: Case.Customer_Satisfaction__c AND the five Account.Satisfaction_* overview fields, readable=true / editable=false everywhere. Assigned to Sales / Customer Service staff (Vertriebsleitung, Account Manager) AND to the Service team (they must read what they wrote). PO-table: Sales = Read only, must not change a rating even with full object access. No object-CRUD in any PS (house SCRUM421_Zuordnung / SCRUM436_CaseReminder). Formula field Satisfaction_Arger__c carries a read entry like house SCRUM398_Eskalationsstufe.
